notablePrerequisites: Opponents can not block Silas Renn.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou to take an extra turn.
Pay {5}, tap Codex Shredder and sacrifice it to return Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Attack with Silas Renn, dealing combat damage.
Cast Codex Shredder from your graveyard.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
